text:
csm_jordan: Heads-up — ACME reported their enterprise-segment CSV export is truncated at exactly 10,000 rows. Dashboard shows ~12.3k usage lines for that segment, invoice matches dashboard, but the CSV they downloaded stops at 10,000 and ends abruptly.

maria_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the export file name + how you generated it? S3 vs UI download? Any errors shown?

csm_jordan: customer says they used Console > Billing > Exports > Export by segment (UI). File name: export-ACME-enterprise-2026-03-10.csv. They tried a second export immediately and got same size. No UI error. They attached a screenshot of the file open in Excel showing final row id = 10000 and last row invoice_id blank.

maria_support: thanks. can you confirm whether the CSV rows correspond to usage events or aggregated rollups? Also need org id, customer account id and export job id if available.

csm_jordan: org_id: org-acme-91, account: acct-9931. Console export job id shown is job_20260310_9931. Customer pasted the first/last 3 lines from the CSV; last lines look truncated mid-record (missing tokens_count column on last line).

maria_support: assigning to @jamie_billing to check whether the export pipeline truncated early or if this is a UI filesize/csv writer limit.

jamie_billing: looking. I see an export job record job_20260310_9931 with status SUCCESS and rows_expected = 12345, rows_written = 10000 in the export_jobs table. That implies the job completed but wrote 10k. Querying logs for ingest-export-worker:

```
2026-03-10T17:22:05Z INFO export-start job=job_20260310_9931 segment=enterprise org=org-acme-91
2026-03-10T17:22:12Z WARN exporter-partition reached page_limit=10000, stopping
2026-03-10T17:22:12Z INFO export-complete job=job_20260310_9931 rows_written=10000
```

jamie_billing: that page_limit warning is suspicious. I don't see it for other orgs at that time. Assigning to @alex_sre and @kevin_eng for deeper look — could be a default pagination cap incorrectly applied to segment exports.

alex_sre: @jamie_billing can you share the exporter config used by that job? I'm wondering if a new config flag `max_write_rows` was mis-set during last deploy.

jamie_billing: config snapshot attached in the job: exporter.max_rows_per_export = 10000 (set in deploy 2026-03-01 as a safety cap). I grep'd for recent changes — safety cap was intended for ad-hoc CSV exports but should not apply to segment exports. Looks like the routing condition exclude was missed.

kevin_eng: I can repro locally by running exporter with segment_export=true vs ad_hoc=true. When segment_export=true, the cap logic short-circuits incorrectly due to a boolean inversion bug in exporter/handler.py: `if not config.safety_cap or export_type == \"segment\": cap = config.max_rows_per_export` (should be and). Minimal repro:

```
# buggy
if not safety_cap or export_type == "segment":
    cap = max_rows

# expected
if safety_cap and export_type == "ad_hoc":
    cap = max_rows
```

kevin_eng: will open PR to fix the condition and add unit tests. Rolling back to previous deploy until patch is live would also fix in-prod.

maria_support: customer asked for immediate workaround: can we trigger a backfill export for that job that ignores the cap and then provide S3 link? Customer is fine with a one-off larger file.

alex_sre: we can run a backfill job with override flag `ignore_safety_cap=true`. I'll start backfill for job_20260310_9931 now. @ingest-bot please schedule job.

ingest-bot: scheduled export_backfill job=backfill_20260310_9931 override_ignore_safety_cap=true for org=org-acme-91; queued on export-worker-7

ingest-bot: job backfill_20260310_9931 status=RUNNING

ingest-bot: job backfill_20260310_9931 status=COMPLETE rows_written=12345 s3://redwood-exports/org-acme-91/export-2026-03-10-enterprise-full.csv

csm_jordan: shared the S3 link with ACME and confirmed they were able to download full file. They asked for ETA on permanent fix and whether any other customers were impacted.

kevin_eng: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4321 — fix conditional, add unit + integration tests for segment exports. I'll push hotfix to release channel after quick code review.

jamie_billing: ran query across export_jobs for last 7 days where rows_written=10000 and rows_expected>10000 and found 7 jobs across 3 orgs (small set). I'll prepare notices for affected customers and schedule backfills.

maria_support: noted. I'll draft emails and CS notes. tagging @kevin_eng for rollout timeline.

kevin_eng: hotfix pushed to prod in release v2026.03.11-hotfix, confirmed segment exports now ignore cap. Running a quick job sweep to auto-backfill any export_jobs with rows_written == max_rows.

alex_sre: sweep results: backfilled 7 jobs, total rows restored = 45,678. No downstream billing reconciliation changes needed (invoices already used aggregated counts), but exports used for customer reconciliation were incomplete. Recommend short postmortem and update release notes.

csm_jordan: thanks team — ACME is satisfied with the backfill and the ETA for fix. Action items: (1) postmortem (kevin), (2) notify affected customers (maria/jamie), (3) add integration test to export e2e (kevin). Closing after postmortem.

kevin_eng: will write postmortem today and tag the infra + billing teams. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: marking thread for follow-up in 72h to confirm no further regressions. :eyes:
